text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy's debut race is finally<n>here! As for
Shinko Windy herself...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Hrngh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: CHOMP!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Kehe! Bwahahaha! Now that was<n>funny!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A harmless bite from Shishimai.<n>She's probably
trying to mask her<n>nerves. But then...
Knock, knock! ♪ You've got company!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's your favorite Umadol! ☆<n>How are you
holding up?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Y-you guys! Did you all come to<n>watch me?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
On your big day? Of course! We're<n>here to root for
you.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I've been watching you<n>every step of the
way. As a keeper of<n>the peace, I can't take my
eyes off<n>an evildoer like you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Rickey, Tarumae, and Acute will be<n>joining us in the
stands too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty tough moving through the<n>crowds in a
big group, so we came on<n>everyone's behalf. ☆

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Ohhh? So everybody's<n>here to see
me do some work, eh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Makes sense. Who wouldn't wanna<n>come and see
history in the making?<n>Hehehehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You seem really excited, Windy.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I was worried you might be hatching<n>another one of
your schemes, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I guess you're just really happy to<n>be making your
debut!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ngh! I dunno if I'd say happy...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, I am glad to be here! This is my<n>first step
towards taking over the<n>racing world!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You're taking over?! I knew this was<n>an evil plot!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Think whatever you want!<n>Maybe I'm
planning something<n>sinister, maybe I'm not!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mngh! Know that when the time<n>comes, Justice
Biko will be there to<n>stop you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you two... ☆ Biko, we should head<n>back. The
race is starting soon.
